summary.text: Karen Simpson is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 3, in Frederick County, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former child protective services caseworker, she has served in the House since January 2023 and chairs the Judiciary Committee's Family Subcommittee.

paragraphs.text: Simpson was born in Baltimore and graduated from Paint Branch High School in 1985.
She earned a B.A. in psychology from Radford University in 1989 and an M.A. in community counseling from Towson University in 1996.

She worked for the Maryland Department of Human Resources from 1992 to 2006 as a child protective services caseworker, program planning and evaluation specialist and program manager, was deputy director of candidacy and campaign finance at the State Board of Elections from 2006 to 2008, and has been a training and education program manager at the Maryland State Retirement Agency since 2008.
Simpson was elected to the House of Delegates in November 2022.
She serves on the Judiciary Committee, chairs its Family Subcommittee, and is also on its Estates and Trusts and Public Safety subcommittees.
